caption:
Fasting tomorrow? Here is why Allah asks us to fast

Allah tells the believers that fasting was prescribed for them as it was for those before them, so that they may become righteous. The aim of a fast is not hunger. It is a heart that grows in righteousness.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:183

Which day this week will you fast for Allah?

#fasting #taqwa #surahbaqarah #quranreels
